claim: The manufacturer treats training as a safety measure: it covers the nature of infrared laser radiation, the hazards, what Class 4 means, the tweezers' safety system, and safe installation and operation.
validity_conditions: Read from Tweez 305/310 Laser Safety Manual V3.0, November 2022, as installed in C:/Program Files/Aresis/Tweez300/Manuals/ (sha256 264ab54b...): printed page 10 (PDF page 12). E3 vendor_spec: the manufacturer's statement, not an observation on this bench. KNOWLEDGE, NOT POLICY: this is what the manufacturer says. What any session may do, and every limit anyone here acts on, is the person's, written into the envelope after confirming it on the instrument.
